name: Fixed glyph, changing world
description: Make a memorable product promise through a consistent visual anchor. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: The one icon that stays in the center of every scene, and the two lines it stands for.

props.text: One icon or symbol, ideally on a transparent background.

props.label: Premise
props.hint: Shows with the glyph at the start.

props.subtitle: Four scenes that appear behind the anchor, one at a time. Each pair shares one label. Leave a scene empty to generate it.

props.text: Optional. Leave it empty and pick an image model to generate it.
Optional. Leave it empty and pick an image model to generate it.
Optional. Leave it empty and pick an image model to generate it.
Optional. Leave it empty and pick an image model to generate it.

props.subtitle: The last frame: the anchor joins your logo and the call to action.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

creativeStrategy.objective: Make a memorable product promise through a consistent visual anchor.
creativeStrategy.direction: The anchor never changes position or silhouette while the world around it changes.

shots.title: One large glyph/icon and a short premise.

elements.direction: Anchor settles in 250 ms.

shots.title: Two worlds appear around the same anchor.

fallback.prompt: A full-bleed photograph of a warm open landscape at golden hour, standing for the line "{label12}" in an ad about "{premise}". Its own vivid palette and light, rich detail, a calm and uncluttered center where an icon will sit. No text, letters, logos or faces.

elements.direction: Cut every 1500 ms; supporting objects move tangentially or scale gently.

reviewRules: Anchor position is identical across cuts.
Each world is distinguishable without relying on its caption.

elements.direction: Repeat timing; vary palette and surrounding objects, not the anchor geometry.

reviewRules: Do not introduce a new grammar on every cut.

fallback.prompt: A full-bleed photograph of a city street at night with neon reflections, standing for the line "{label34}" in an ad about "{premise}". Its own vivid palette and light, rich detail, a calm and uncluttered center where an icon will sit. No text, letters, logos or faces.

shots.title: Anchor becomes part of the brand/CTA lockup.

elements.direction: Hold.

reviewRules: The final brand and CTA are fully settled and readable.

beats: 0–1.5 s: One large glyph/icon and a short premise. Shows Brand color, Anchor glyph, Premise.
1.5–4.5 s: Two worlds appear around the same anchor. Shows Brand color, World 1, Anchor glyph, Label for worlds 1 and 2.
4.5–7.5 s: Two more worlds expand the range. Shows Brand color, World 2, Anchor glyph, Label for worlds 1 and 2.
7.5–9.5 s: Worlds clear to reveal the concrete promise. Shows Brand color, World 3, Anchor glyph, Label for worlds 3 and 4.
9.5–12 s: Anchor becomes part of the brand/CTA lockup. Shows Brand color, World 4, Anchor glyph, Label for worlds 3 and 4.
